# The monastery candidates

Three maps of a cliffside monastery (v5, v6, v7) authored in August 2026 by the retired
authoring loop, kept as varied inputs for library tests (apertures, lighting, rules, keys, switches,
sprite seating and others). They are fixtures, not levels: nothing rebuilds them. Their project,
`projects/reasoned-authoring-v1`, was retired on 2026-11-26 and is in git history.
